sentences.text:
Rekha Devi, aged about 52 years, W/o Sunil Tiwary, R/o village Madhopur, P.O. Nayasankho, P.S.
Deori, District Giridih ... ... Petitioner -Versus - The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party ------
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Tarun Kumar No.1, Advocate For the State : M/s. Vishwanath Roy, A.P.P.
-----
04/04.10.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Deori P.S. Case No. 143 of 2021, for the offences registered under Sections 376(3), 313, 417 and 506/34 of the I.P.C. and Section 4/8 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge POCSO Act, Giridih.
3. The brother of the petitioner is said to have established consensual physical relationship with the informant due to which she became pregnant.
4. It was submitted that the statement of the victim has been recorded during the trial in which she has not supported the prosecution case and she has been declared hostile.

It was further submitted that the accused against whom there is specific allegation of having established consensual physical relationship with the victim has been granted bail by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
4. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.
Accordingly, the Rekha Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
